verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client, and SSH clients can plausibly offer system-wide tunneling, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only local, remote and dynamic SSH port forwarding. Dynamic forwarding is a related SOCKS-proxy feature, not exit-node routing of all device traffic, and the pack has no evidence of exit-node or full-traffic routing.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can route all my internet traffic through a specific device on my network using an exit node
